events.label: 43 children born same day; seven adopted by Reginald
events.description: On the same day, forty-three babies are born to mothers who had shown no sign of pregnancy. An eccentric billionaire adopts seven of them and raises them to be a team of superheroes.

events.label: Five jumps to apocalyptic future wasteland
events.description: The stubborn young Number Five, tired of waiting, throws himself forward in time and lands alone in a ruined future where the world has already ended.

events.label: Five works as Commission assassin across time
events.description: Trapped in the wasteland, Five is recruited by a shadowy office called the Commission, which sends assassins across history to keep events on their intended course. He works for them for decades.

events.label: Five returns warning of 2019 apocalypse
events.description: Five finally finds his way back to his teenage years and delivers terrible news to his adopted brothers and sisters: the world ends in just over a week.

events.label: Viktor's power + Commission → Moon apocalypse
events.description: Viktor's enormous, long-suppressed powers are unleashed, and the family learns this is what destroys the world - setting off the very catastrophe Five warned about.

events.label: Five jumps siblings to 1960s Dallas
events.description: With the end of the world unstoppable in their own time, Five uses a stolen briefcase to drag all his siblings away - and they land scattered across 1960s Dallas.

events.label: Avert 1960s apocalypse; briefcase home to rewritten present
events.description: The siblings settle into 1960s lives, stop a second doomsday, and squeeze back into their briefcase to return home - only to find the present has changed under them.

events.label: Home replaced by Sparrow Academy timeline
events.description: Back in the present, the siblings discover their mansion belongs to a different adopted family of super-powered strangers, the Sparrow Academy - because Reginald never took them in in this version of history.

events.label: Paradox Umbrellas → Kugelblitz eats universe
events.description: The two families' existences clash, tearing a hole in reality called a kugelblitz - a hungry ball of black hole that swallows the universe piece by piece.

events.label: Commission Founder is elderly alternate Five
events.description: It emerges that the shadowy Commission was created and run by an elderly version of Five himself from another branch of history.

events.label: Five & Lila lost years in multiverse subway
events.description: Five and his sister-in-law Lila tumble through a labyrinth of secret stations beneath time itself, and wander them for years before finding a way back.

events.label: Max's Deli: ~145412 variant Fives; Umbrellas always end worlds
events.description: At a deli at the end of time, Five meets a whole population of alternate Fives, and learns the bitter truth: no matter what, his family always ends the world.

events.label: Marigold+durango cancel — erase Umbrellas from history
events.description: To save all of existence, the siblings give up their powers and let their unusual origins be undone - erasing themselves from history so a clean world can exist.

events.label: Clean timeline; strangers live peaceful lives
events.description: In the final world, with no powers and no Academy, the brothers and sisters live as ordinary strangers - but can still be seen crossing paths, alive and at peace.

events.label: Apocalypse countdown
events.description: The countdown begins: the Hargreeves children learn the world is due to end within days, and their own choices are what set the clock ticking.

events.label: Number Five time jumps
events.description: Number Five can blink through time, though the jumps are wild and hard to control - they strand him for decades and shape his whole life.

events.label: Temps Commission bureaucracy
events.description: The Temps Commission is the faceless agency quietly managing history, sending agents up and down time to make sure the apocalypse it profits from happens as written.

events.label: S2 1960s timeline
events.description: Stranded separately in 1960s Dallas, each sibling builds a new life - until their presence there starts a fresh doomsday they must defuse together.

events.label: Kugelblitz / S3 reset
events.description: After the siblings return home and find history rewritten around them, rival families collide and a kugelblitz - a black hole devouring the universe - begins to grow.

events.label: Sparrow Academy variant family
events.description: In the rewritten present, another version of the family exists: the Sparrow Academy, seven strangers with the same powers and none of the sibling history.

events.label: Timeline resets / endings
events.description: Each series ends with history rewritten or remade around the family - a new present, a new threat, and the siblings carrying the memories no one else has.

events.label: Sibling bonds across resets
events.description: Whatever version of history they land in, the adopted siblings keep finding each other: the family bond survives every reset of the world.

ruleEffects.effect: Ultimate prune: remove the anomaly (themselves) rather than trim branches
Commission was founded by a Five — erased with them

outcome.summary: Siblings erase themselves; clean timeline without Umbrella/Commission apocalypse engine.
